newsitem.title: USA: Sportsman Guide proposes reverse split.
newsitem.headline: Sportsman Guide proposes reverse split.

text.p: The board of directors of Sportsmans Guide Inc said Monday it is proposing a one-for-10 reverse stock split, subject to shareholder approval.

If the reverse split is approved by shareholders, it will reduce the number of outstanding shares of common stock from 23,335,833 to about 2,333,583, the company said. A special meeting of shareholders to approve this action is planned for March 5, 1997.

Sportsman Guide said it believes the reverse stock split would increase the marketability and liquidity of the stock. It said it expects an anticipated increased price of the stock because of a reverse split would draw greater interest in the stock.
In addition, the company said it would expect a reverse stock split to help it to qualify for trading on Nasdaq and plans to file an application as soon as the company qualifies.
Sportsman Guide markets outdoor, hunting and surplus merchandise.
